title: helmdeck-pack manifest
description: Schema for the per-pack helmdeck-pack.yaml manifest. Every pack in the marketplace MUST have a manifest that validates against this schema. See helmdeck ADR 034 for the design rationale.

name.description: Pack name in <family>.<verb> form. Globally unique within the catalog. Lowercase alphanumerics + underscore only; one dot separator.

version.description: Pack version. Semver (v1, v1.2.0) or date-style (2026.05). Bump on every change.

author.description: GitHub username or organization. Surfaces in the UI's pack-detail view.

license.description: SPDX identifier for the handler's license. Apache-2.0, MIT, BSD-3-Clause, etc. Strongly recommended; defaults to 'unspecified' when omitted.

description.description: One-paragraph plain-English summary. Surfaces in the catalog list.

needs_session.description: True if the pack reads/writes session-scoped filesystem state (e.g. cloned repos under /tmp/helmdeck-clone-X). Determines whether the engine acquires a session before dispatching.

input_schema.description: JSON-Schema-style description of the pack's input. Validated by the engine before dispatch.

output_schema.description: JSON-Schema-style description of the pack's output. Validated by the engine after the handler returns.

handler.description: How the engine invokes the pack. Type determines the rest of the shape.

expected_output_subset.description: Optional partial output to assert against. Test runner checks every key in this object is present in the actual output and matches.

examples.description: Worked input/output pairs the validation CI runs against.

signed_by.description: GitHub identity that signed this pack via cosign. Populated by the signing workflow; not author-managed.

sha256.description: SHA256 of the pack directory tarball. Populated by the signing workflow.

trust.description: Trust metadata. Authors do NOT populate this — the signing workflow at release time does.

required.description: Field names that must be present on every call.

properties.description: Per-field type declarations. Mirrors helmdeck's BasicSchema (internal/packs/schema.go).

handlerBuiltin.description: Reserved for core packs compiled into the helmdeck binary. Not allowed in community marketplace packs.

command.description: argv list for the handler subprocess. Paths are resolved relative to the pack's directory.

timeout_s.description: Wall-clock cap. The pack caller's context still wins if it cancels first.

env.description: Per-call env vars in KEY=VALUE form. Do NOT put secrets here — use the vault.

max_output_bytes.description: stdout cap. Excess bytes are silently truncated.

image.description: Container image the handler executes inside. When absent, the installer uses helmdeck's default helmdeck-sidecar-marketplace image (bundles bash + jq + curl + python3 + node 20 + standard Unix utils). Declare this when your pack needs a heavier toolchain (e.g. ffmpeg, ImageMagick, ML inference libraries). Per ADR 038 in tosin2013/helmdeck.

sidecar.description: Per-pack sidecar override for the handler runtime. See ADR 038 in tosin2013/helmdeck.

args.description: Argument map for the pack. Values prefixed with `$.` are JSONPath references into the input or previous-step outputs (e.g. `$.input.topic`, `$.steps[0].output.summary`).

module.description: Path to the .wasm module, relative to the pack directory.

capabilities.description: WASI capabilities the module needs. Operators approve each at install time.

handlerWasm.description: Phase 8 only — WASM/WASI sandbox. Not yet implemented in helmdeck v0.13.0.
